main.description: A keeper RELAY (継ぎ, G5): finite keepers in succession — no sleepless center, no permanent universal keeper (ADR-2606112200 D3 NEVER-a-throne; 詩篇121:4 realized as relay). The kept's standing covenant carries over only via a fresh offer + consent by the incoming keeper.
